pages.text: $(item)Iced Tea$() — right-click to throw! Anyone hit gets to enjoy an extremely embarrassing sound clip...«Boss, I missed you [crying][crying]»
$(item)Kidney Tonic$() — grants 5 minutes of Strength when eaten. Strong kidneys, strong body!
$(item)Growth Agent$() / $(item)Reverse Growth Agent$() — injections that grow or shrink the target's body size (±0.1 per dose). Where lolicons and giant-lovers meet~
$(item)C50H68N14O10$() (Bremelanotide) — puts the target into a long $(#FF69B4)estrus$() state with nausea on the side. The chemical formula is printed right on the item. Professional, meow~
$(item)Strange Fleshy Lump$() and $(item)Feces$() — technically edible... causes nausea though. WHO exactly is eating this?!
